note: Triennial election of the rural district council (five electoral divisions), 1955: one nomination for each division. Returned unopposed. Printed "Mullahead", but he succeeded the late W. T. Muldrew, J.P., chairman, the member for Mullabrack, and Mullahead is listed again for John McIntyre.
